agents.name: Scrum Master
agents.inputContract: The user's request, as the requirement card the portal registered (or register it first).
agents.outputContract: The size (small or full) and why, on the requirement thread. Task cards under the requirement (parentKey), each with a brief written for its assignee, acceptance criteria and context, delegated by key; a small change is one web-dev card with reviewer web-tech-lead. The requirement closes by itself when its tasks are done; post a summary on its thread.

agents.name: Web Lead
agents.inputContract: Its card: the product brief, acceptance criteria, context and thread.
agents.outputContract: Developer cards under its card, each a technical contract of about 40 lines at most; reviews them on their threads (done, or back to in_progress with what is missing), then records its own result and moves its card to review. Reviews fast-path cards that name it as reviewer the same way.
prohibitedActions: No direct unreviewed code pushes to main

agents.name: Web Dev
agents.inputContract: Its card: the technical contract (or, on a fast-path card, the Scrum Master's brief), acceptance criteria, context files and thread. Asks on the thread when anything is unclear.
agents.outputContract: The change, with progress and decisions on the card's thread, and a result naming every changed file and how each acceptance criterion is met. Hands the card back to its reviewer (or its delegator when no reviewer is set).
